title: Weekly cash-flow update
scene: Every Sunday you send the Finance Director the weekly cash position. This week payments are higher than expected collections, and there is a shortfall on the day salaries are due. You must explain the numbers and propose priorities.
sceneAr: كل حد بتبعت للمدير المالي موقف الكاش الأسبوعي. الأسبوع ده المدفوعات أكتر من التحصيلات المتوقعة وفيه عجز يوم المرتبات، ولازم تشرح الأرقام وتقترح أولويات.

thread.subject: Cash position – week of 4–10 October
body: Hi,
Please send me the cash-flow update for this week before the management meeting at 1 pm today.
I am worried about 8 October. We have salaries, the VAT return and the second payment to Shenzhen VoltTech on the same week, and Delta Pharma has not paid INV-0457 yet.
I need the opening balance, expected collections, planned payments and your suggestion if we are short.

Thanks,
Hany Zaki
Finance Director

thread.subject: RE: Cash position – week of 4–10 October
thread.task: ابعت موقف الكاش: الرصيد، التحصيلات، المدفوعات، العجز، واقترح ترتيب أولويات الدفع.

opts: Here is the numbers you asked.
Please find below the cash-flow update for the week of 4–10 October.
I send to you the cash flow now.
steps.why: جملة مهنية وواضحة ومحددة بالأسبوع؛ التانيين فيهم أخطاء نحوية.

steps.sentence: This leaves a ___ of about EGP 1.6 million on 8 October.
steps.why: ‎shortfall‎ هي الكلمة المالية المظبوطة للعجز في الكاش.

parts: Our opening balance today is EGP 4.2 million.
We expect collections of EGP 6.1 million and payments of EGP 7.9 million this week.
This leaves a shortfall of about EGP 1.6 million on 8 October.
steps.why: الرصيد الأول، بعدين الداخل والخارج، وبعدين النتيجة (العجز).

steps.q: How do you propose the priorities?
opts: You must pay salaries first, it is obvious.
I suggest we protect salaries and VAT first and ask VoltTech to accept their payment one week later.
Maybe we don't pay anybody until money comes.
steps.why: اقتراح مؤدب وواضح بـ ‎I suggest‎ مش أمر ولا كلام مش عملي.

body: Dear Mr. Hany,
Please find below the cash-flow update for the week of 4–10 October.
Our opening balance today is EGP 4.2 million. We expect collections of EGP 6.1 million and payments of EGP 7.9 million this week. This leaves a shortfall of about EGP 1.6 million on 8 October.
The main payments are salaries (EGP 3.4 million), September VAT (EGP 1.1 million) and USD 38,000 to Shenzhen VoltTech.
I suggest we protect salaries and VAT first and ask VoltTech to accept their payment one week later. I will also chase Delta Pharma for INV-0457 (EGP 1.35 million) today.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Treasury Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Cash position – week of 4–10 October
body: Thanks, clear.
I agree with the priorities. Salaries must go out on 8 October, no delay. VAT also cannot be late, because the penalty is high.

I called Mr. Wang Lei and he can accept the VoltTech payment on 15 October, but he wants it in writing. Please also confirm with Delta Pharma when exactly they will transfer, and send me an updated position on Tuesday.
Hany

thread.subject: RE: Cash position – week of 4–10 October
thread.task: ابعت التحديث يوم التلات: تأكيد تحويل دلتا فارما، تأجيل ‎VoltTech‎ كتابةً، والموقف الجديد.

opts: As requested, here is the updated cash position.
Like you said me, this is the new position.
steps.why: ‎As requested‎ مؤدبة ومختصرة؛ التانية ترجمة حرفية والتالتة ناشفة.

steps.sentence: Ms. Dalia Fawzy has ___ that Delta Pharma will transfer EGP 1.35 million on 7 October.
steps.why: ‎confirmed‎ معناها أكدت رسمي، ودي أهم حاجة في التحصيل.

parts: Ms. Dalia Fawzy has confirmed that Delta Pharma will transfer EGP 1.35 million on 7 October.
Mr. Wang Lei has also confirmed by email that VoltTech accepts payment on 15 October.
With these two changes, we no longer have a shortfall on 8 October.
steps.why: التحصيل، بعدين التأجيل، بعدين النتيجة.

body: Dear Mr. Hany,
As requested, here is the updated cash position.
Ms. Dalia Fawzy has confirmed that Delta Pharma will transfer EGP 1.35 million on 7 October. Mr. Wang Lei has also confirmed by email that VoltTech accepts payment on 15 October.
With these two changes, we no longer have a shortfall on 8 October. The expected closing balance on 8 October is about EGP 0.6 million after salaries and VAT.
I will check the Delta Pharma transfer tomorrow morning and update you immediately if it does not arrive.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Treasury Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: Please find below the cash-flow update
This leaves a shortfall of about…
I suggest we protect salaries first
we no longer have a shortfall
I will update you immediately if…

title: The failed salary transfer
scene: You uploaded the September payroll file to the bank. The bank processed all transfers except one, because the account number is wrong. Salaries must reach employees on 29 September.
sceneAr: رفعت ملف مرتبات سبتمبر على البنك. البنك نفّذ كل التحويلات إلا واحد عشان رقم الحساب غلط، والمرتبات لازم توصل يوم 29 سبتمبر.

thread.from: Ms. Rania Fouad — Nile Commercial Bank
thread.subject: Payroll file PAY-SEP-2026 – 1 rejected transfer
body: Dear Sir/Madam,
Your payroll file PAY-SEP-2026 (212 transfers, total EGP 3,412,800) was processed with value date 29 September.
211 transfers were successful. One transfer was rejected: employee ID 1047, Mr. Mahmoud Adel, EGP 14,650. Reason: invalid account number.
Please send the correct account details before 1 pm on Monday 28 September to keep the same value date.

Kind regards,
Rania Fouad
Corporate Payroll Services
Nile Commercial Bank

thread.subject: RE: Payroll file PAY-SEP-2026 – 1 rejected transfer
thread.task: اشكر البنك، ابعت رقم الحساب الصح للموظف، واطلب نفس تاريخ القيمة.

opts: Thank you for your email and for processing the payroll file.
steps.why: تبدأ بشكر مهني قبل الطلب؛ الأولى فيها اتهام وغلط نحوي.

steps.sentence: We checked with Mr. Mahmoud Adel, and one ___ was missing from his account number.
steps.why: ‎digit‎ = رقم واحد من الأرقام.

parts: We checked with Mr. Mahmoud Adel, and one digit was missing from his account number.
The correct account number is 1002 4587 3316 0 at your Heliopolis branch.
Could you please process the transfer of EGP 14,650 with the same value date, 29 September?
steps.why: السبب، بعدين البيانات الصح، بعدين الطلب.

body: Dear Ms. Rania,
Thank you for your email and for processing the payroll file.
We checked with Mr. Mahmoud Adel, and one digit was missing from his account number. The correct account number is 1002 4587 3316 0 at your Heliopolis branch.
Could you please process the transfer of EGP 14,650 with the same value date, 29 September? I have attached a copy of his bank card for your reference.
Please let me know if you need anything else.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Payroll Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Ms. Rania Fouad — Nile Commercial Bank
thread.subject: RE: Payroll file PAY-SEP-2026 – 1 rejected transfer
body: Dear Sir,
Thank you for the details. Unfortunately, we cannot change payroll data based on an email only.
We need a signed instruction letter from one of your authorised signatories, with the company stamp, showing the employee name, the correct account number and the amount.
If we receive it before 1 pm today, the salary will be credited on 29 September.

Kind regards,
Rania Fouad

thread.subject: RE: Payroll file PAY-SEP-2026 – 1 rejected transfer
thread.task: ابعت خطاب التعليمات الموقّع قبل الساعة 1 واطلب تأكيد التنفيذ.

opts: Please find attached the signed instruction letter, as requested.
I attach you the paper you want.
This is the letter, do it fast please.
steps.why: ‎Please find attached‎ … ‎as requested‎ هي الصيغة المعتادة لإرسال مستند.

steps.sentence: The letter is signed by Mr. Hany Zaki, our Finance Director, and ___ with the company stamp.
steps.why: ‎stamped‎ = مختوم بختم الشركة.

parts: Please find attached the signed instruction letter, as requested.
The letter is signed by Mr. Hany Zaki, our Finance Director, and stamped with the company stamp.
The original will be delivered to your branch by our courier this afternoon.
Could you kindly confirm once the transfer is done?
steps.why: المرفق، تفاصيله، الأصل، وبعدين طلب التأكيد في الآخر.

body: Dear Ms. Rania,
Please find attached the signed instruction letter, as requested.
The letter is signed by Mr. Hany Zaki, our Finance Director, and stamped with the company stamp. It shows Mr. Mahmoud Adel, account number 1002 4587 3316 0 and the amount of EGP 14,650.
The original will be delivered to your branch by our courier this afternoon.
Could you kindly confirm once the transfer is done? The employee is waiting for his salary.
Thank you for your help.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Payroll Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: Thank you for processing the payroll file
The original will be delivered to your branch
Could you kindly confirm once … is done?

title: Salary advance request
scene: A service technician asks for a salary advance for a family emergency. The amount is higher than company policy allows. You must explain the policy kindly, offer a solution, and then send the approval.
sceneAr: فني صيانة طالب سلفة عشان ظرف عائلي. المبلغ أكبر من المسموح في سياسة الشركة، فلازم تشرح السياسة بلطف وتقترح حل وبعدين تبعت الموافقة.

thread.subject: Request for salary advance
body: Dear Accounts team,
I would like to request a salary advance of EGP 30,000. My mother needs an operation next week and the hospital asked for payment in advance.
I can repay the amount from my salary over six months.
I am sorry for the short notice. Please tell me what I need to do.

Thank you,
Ahmed Ragab
Service Technician, Maintenance Dept.

thread.subject: RE: Request for salary advance
thread.task: اتعاطف معاه، اشرح السياسة (بحد أقصى شهرين من الأساسي و6 أقساط)، واقترح مبلغ وخطوات.

opts: Your request is refused because of the policy.
I am sorry to hear about your mother, and I hope the operation goes well.
We received your mail about the money problem.
steps.why: تبدأ بتعاطف إنساني قبل ما تدخل في السياسة؛ الأولى ناشفة وغلط.

steps.sentence: According to our policy, a salary advance can be up to two months of basic ___.
steps.why: ‎basic salary‎ = المرتب الأساسي، تعبير ثابت.

parts: According to our policy, a salary advance can be up to two months of basic salary.
In your case, this is EGP 24,000, repaid in six monthly instalments of EGP 4,000.
If this works for you, please fill in the attached advance form and ask Eng. Mostafa to sign it.
steps.why: القاعدة، تطبيقها عليه، وبعدين الخطوة الجاية.

body: Dear Ahmed,
I am sorry to hear about your mother, and I hope the operation goes well.
According to our policy, a salary advance can be up to two months of basic salary. In your case, this is EGP 24,000, repaid in six monthly instalments of EGP 4,000.
If this works for you, please fill in the attached advance form and ask Eng. Mostafa to sign it. Once we receive it, Ms. Nadia Hassan can approve it the same day.
Please let me know if you have any questions.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Payroll Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Request for salary advance
body: Dear Sir,
Thank you very much for your quick reply. EGP 24,000 is fine, and my family will cover the rest.
Please find attached the form, signed by Eng. Mostafa Saleh, Service Manager.
Can the money be transferred before Sunday? The operation is on Monday 5 October, and the hospital needs the payment one day before.

Many thanks,
Ahmed Ragab

thread.subject: RE: Request for salary advance – approved
thread.task: ابعت إيميل الموافقة: المبلغ، ميعاد التحويل، وجدول خصم الأقساط، مع نسخة لنادية.

opts: We accepted to give you the advance after discussion.
Good news, your advance has been approved.
steps.why: إيجابية ومهنية؛ التانية كاجوال زيادة والتالتة ترجمة حرفية.

steps.sentence: The amount of EGP 24,000 will be ___ to your salary account on Saturday 3 October.
steps.why: ‎transferred to your account‎ هي الصيغة البنكية المعتادة.

parts: The amount of EGP 24,000 will be transferred to your salary account on Saturday 3 October.
EGP 4,000 will be deducted from your salary each month, from October 2026 to March 2027.
You will see the deduction on your payslip as "Salary advance".
steps.why: التحويل، بعدين الخصم، بعدين إزاي هيظهر في قسيمة المرتب.

steps.sentence: We wish your mother a quick ___.
steps.why: ‎a quick recovery‎ تعبير ثابت للتمني بالشفاء.

body: Dear Ahmed,
Good news, your advance has been approved.
The amount of EGP 24,000 will be transferred to your salary account on Saturday 3 October. EGP 4,000 will be deducted from your salary each month, from October 2026 to March 2027.
You will see the deduction on your payslip as "Salary advance". Our reference for this advance is ADV-2026-014.
We wish your mother a quick recovery.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Payroll Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

Cc: Ms. Nadia Hassan, Chief Accountant

phrases: I am sorry to hear about…
Good news, your … has been approved
will be deducted from your salary each month

title: Bank letter & signatories
scene: The Finance Director asks you to get an account statement and a bank letter for a hospital tender, and to update the authorised signatories. The bank replies that some documents are missing, and the tender deadline is close.
sceneAr: المدير المالي طلب منك كشف حساب وخطاب بنك لمناقصة المستشفى، وكمان تحديث المفوضين بالتوقيع. البنك رد إن فيه ورق ناقص، وميعاد المناقصة قرّب.

thread.subject: Bank documents – Horizon Hospital tender
body: Hi,
For the Horizon Hospital tender (closing 12 October) we need a bank letter confirming our account and good standing, plus the account statement for July–September.
Also, please ask the bank to update our authorised signatories: add Ms. Nadia Hassan and remove Mr. Samy Wahba, who left the company last month.
Please send the request today and copy me. The bank usually needs a few days, so we should not wait.

Thanks,
Hany

thread.subject: Request: bank letter, statement and update of signatories – A/C 1002 3390 118
thread.task: اكتب للمسؤول في البنك: اطلب خطاب وكشف حساب وتحديث المفوضين، ووضّح الميعاد.

opts: I hope you are well. I am writing to request three items for our account no. 1002 3390 118.
We want some papers from the bank quickly.
Kindly do the needful for our account.
steps.why: واضحة ومحددة برقم الحساب؛ ‎do the needful‎ قديمة ومش واضحة.

steps.sentence: A bank letter confirming that our account is in good ___, addressed to Horizon Hospital.
steps.why: ‎in good standing‎ = الحساب سليم ومفيش عليه مشاكل، تعبير ثابت.

parts: A bank letter confirming that our account is in good standing, addressed to Horizon Hospital.
The account statement for July, August and September 2026.
An update of our authorised signatories: adding Ms. Nadia Hassan and removing Mr. Samy Wahba.
steps.why: نفس ترتيب طلب المدير: الخطاب، الكشف، بعدين المفوضين.

body: Dear Mr. Omar,
I hope you are well. I am writing to request three items for our account no. 1002 3390 118:

1) A bank letter confirming that our account is in good standing, addressed to Horizon Hospital.
2) The account statement for July, August and September 2026.
3) An update of our authorised signatories: adding Ms. Nadia Hassan and removing Mr. Samy Wahba.
We need the letter and statement by 8 October for a tender. Could you please tell us which documents you need for the signatory change?

Best regards,
<Your name>
Treasury Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

thread.from: Mr. Omar Sabry — Nile Commercial Bank
thread.subject: RE: Request: bank letter, statement and update of signatories – A/C 1002 3390 118
body: Dear Sir,
The statement and the bank letter will be ready within two working days.

For the signatory change, we need: a board resolution signed by the chairman, a copy of Ms. Nadia's national ID, a commercial register extract issued less than 3 months ago, and Ms. Nadia must sign the specimen signature card at the branch.
Also, the bank letter fee is EGP 250, which will be debited from your account.

Best regards,
Omar Sabry
Relationship Manager

thread.subject: RE: Request: bank letter, statement and update of signatories – A/C 1002 3390 118
thread.task: ابعت الورق الموجود، قول إمتى الناقص هيوصل، حدد ميعاد لنادية في الفرع، وأكّد على ميعاد الخطاب.

steps.q: How do you explain the missing document?
opts: The commercial register is not with us, sorry, we can't.
We have requested a new commercial register extract, and we expect to send it to you by 8 October.
steps.why: بتقول عملت إيه وإمتى هيوصل؛ ده بيطمّن البنك.

steps.sentence: Please find attached the board resolution and a copy of Ms. Nadia's national ___.
steps.why: ‎national ID‎ = البطاقة الشخصية.

parts: Please find attached the board resolution and a copy of Ms. Nadia's national ID.
We have requested a new commercial register extract, and we expect to send it to you by 8 October.
Ms. Nadia can visit the branch on Tuesday 6 October at 11 am to sign the specimen card.
Meanwhile, could you please release the bank letter and the statement, as they are not linked to the signatory change?
steps.why: اللي معاك، اللي ناقص، الزيارة، وبعدين الطلب المهم في الآخر.

body: Dear Mr. Omar,
Thank you for the quick reply.
Please find attached the board resolution and a copy of Ms. Nadia's national ID. We have requested a new commercial register extract, and we expect to send it to you by 8 October.
Ms. Nadia can visit the branch on Tuesday 6 October at 11 am to sign the specimen card. Please confirm if this time suits you.
Meanwhile, could you please release the bank letter and the statement, as they are not linked to the signatory change? We agree to the EGP 250 fee.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Treasury Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: Could you please tell us which documents you need?
We expect to send it to you by…
Please confirm if this time suits you
ياريت تأكد لو الميعاد ده مناسب

title: Early payment to a supplier
scene: Purchasing asks you to pay an Italian supplier's invoice now, although the payment terms are 60 days, because the supplier offers a discount. You need the right documents and approval, and then you find that not all goods were received.
sceneAr: المشتريات طالبين تدفع فاتورة مورد إيطالي دلوقتي رغم إن شروط الدفع 60 يوم، عشان المورد عارض خصم. محتاج الورق والموافقة، وبعدين تكتشف إن البضاعة موصلتش كلها.

thread.subject: Urgent: early payment – EuroDrive invoice INV-ED-2291
body: Hi,
Can you please pay EuroDrive invoice INV-ED-2291 (EUR 18,400) this week?
Our terms are 60 days, but Mr. Marco Bianchi offers a 2% discount if we pay within 10 days. He also promised to ship our next order of VFDs one week earlier.
The drives are for the Delta Pharma project, so this is important for sales.

Thanks,
Amr Lotfy
Purchasing Officer

thread.subject: RE: Urgent: early payment – EuroDrive invoice INV-ED-2291
thread.task: وافق مبدئيًا بس اطلب الورق: أمر الشراء، إذن الاستلام، تأكيد الخصم كتابةً، وموافقة المدير المالي.

opts: No, the terms are 60 days. Finish.
Thanks for your email. A 2% discount is a good offer, and we are happy to look at it.
Okay I will pay it now directly.
steps.why: إيجابي من غير ما توعد بالدفع قبل الورق والموافقة.

steps.sentence: Before we can pay ahead of the due ___, I need the following:
steps.why: ‎due date‎ = تاريخ الاستحقاق.

parts: Before we can pay ahead of the due date, I need the following:
Once I have these, I will ask Mr. Hany Zaki to approve the early payment.
If everything is complete by Sunday, we can pay on Tuesday 6 October.
steps.why: المطلوب، بعدين الموافقة، بعدين ميعاد الدفع المتوقع.

body: Hi Amr,
Thanks for your email. A 2% discount is a good offer, and we are happy to look at it.

Before we can pay ahead of the due date, I need the following:
- PO-2026-142 and the goods received note (GRN)
- Mr. Marco's written confirmation of the 2% discount
Once I have these, I will ask Mr. Hany Zaki to approve the early payment. If everything is complete by Sunday, we can pay on Tuesday 6 October.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Urgent: early payment – EuroDrive invoice INV-ED-2291
body: Hi,
Attached are PO-2026-142, GRN-0931 and Marco's email confirming the 2% discount.
One small point: the GRN shows 18 drives received, not 20. Youssef says two drives are still with FastClear at Alexandria port because of a customs document. Marco says they will arrive next week.
Can we still pay the full invoice? Marco says the discount is only valid until 9 October.
Amr

thread.subject: RE: Urgent: early payment – EuroDrive invoice INV-ED-2291
thread.task: وضّح إنك هتدفع بس اللي اتستلم (18 درايف) بعد الخصم، والباقي لما يوصل، واطلب فاتورة معدّلة.

steps.q: How do you say no to the full payment?
opts: Of course not, we are not stupid.
I'm afraid we can only pay for the goods we have received.
Full payment is not possible because Youssef made a mistake.
steps.why: ‎I‎'‎m afraid‎ بترفض بأدب ومن غير ما تلوم حد.

steps.sentence: Mr. Hany has ___ an early payment for 18 drives, which is EUR 16,560.
steps.why: ‎approve‎ + مفعول مباشر = وافق على (من غير ‎on‎).

parts: Mr. Hany has approved an early payment for 18 drives, which is EUR 16,560.
After the 2% discount, we will transfer EUR 16,228.80 on Tuesday 6 October.
We will pay the remaining two drives when Youssef confirms delivery.
steps.why: الموافقة، بعدين المبلغ بعد الخصم، بعدين الباقي.

steps.sentence: Could you please ask Mr. Marco to send us a revised invoice for the ___ amount?
steps.why: ‎partial amount‎ = مبلغ جزئي.

body: Hi Amr,
Thanks for the documents. I'm afraid we can only pay for the goods we have received.
Mr. Hany has approved an early payment for 18 drives, which is EUR 16,560. After the 2% discount, we will transfer EUR 16,228.80 on Tuesday 6 October.
We will pay the remaining two drives when Youssef confirms delivery.
Could you please ask Mr. Marco to send us a revised invoice for the partial amount? The bank will need it for the transfer.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

phrases: We are happy to look at it
Before we can pay ahead of the due date,…
قبل ما نقدر ندفع قبل ميعاد الاستحقاق،…
Once I have these, I will…
أول ما يكون معايا ده، هـ…
I'm afraid we can only pay for…
a revised invoice for the partial amount

title: Month-end closing
scene: The Chief Accountant needs to close September by 5 October. Some departments have not sent their invoices and reports yet. You must chase them politely and handle a stock difference from the warehouse.
sceneAr: رئيسة الحسابات لازم تقفل شهر سبتمبر قبل 5 أكتوبر، وفيه إدارات لسه مبعتتش الفواتير والتقارير. لازم تتابع معاهم بأدب وتتعامل مع فرق في جرد المخزن.

thread.subject: September closing – missing documents
body: Hi,
We must close September and send the reports to Mr. Hany by Monday 5 October.
We are still missing: supplier invoices from Purchasing (at least 7), signed service job cards from Maintenance for the Horizon Hospital contract, and the month-end stock count from the Warehouse.
Please chase the three departments tomorrow morning and give them a clear deadline.

Thanks,
Nadia

thread.subject: Reminder: September closing – documents needed by Thursday 2 Oct
thread.task: اكتب تذكير مهذب لرؤساء الإدارات التلاتة: مين محتاج يبعت إيه، والميعاد النهائي، ولماذا.

opts: You are late again with the documents.
This is a friendly reminder that we are closing the September accounts this week.
steps.why: ‎friendly reminder‎ بتتابع من غير ما تلوم حد.

steps.sentence: Could you please send the following documents by Thursday 2 October at 3 pm at the ___?
steps.why: ‎at the latest‎ = بحد أقصى (للمواعيد).

parts: This is a friendly reminder that we are closing the September accounts this week.
Could you please send the following documents by Thursday 2 October at 3 pm at the latest?
If any document will be late, please let me know today so we can plan around it.
steps.why: السبب، الطلب والميعاد، وبعدين باب مفتوح للمشاكل.

body: Dear colleagues,
This is a friendly reminder that we are closing the September accounts this week.

Could you please send the following documents by Thursday 2 October at 3 pm at the latest?
- Purchasing: all September supplier invoices (7 are still missing)
- Maintenance: signed job cards for the Horizon Hospital contract
- Warehouse: the month-end stock count sheets
If any document will be late, please let me know today so we can plan around it.
Thank you for your support.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

thread.subject: RE: Reminder: September closing – documents needed by Thursday 2 Oct
body: Hi,
The stock count is done, but there is a difference: the system shows 148 batteries 12V 100Ah and we counted 145.
I think the 3 units went to the Horizon Hospital site without a delivery note. I am checking with the service team.
Can I send the count sheets on Sunday after I find the answer? I don't want to send a report with a difference that I cannot explain.
Youssef

body: Hi Youssef,
Thanks for the update, and well done for finding the difference early.
Please send the count sheets tomorrow by 12 noon, with a short note about the difference. We can record the 3 batteries as a pending reconciliation item and close the month on time.
Once the service team confirms, please ask them to issue the missing delivery note. We will then charge the batteries to the Horizon Hospital contract.
Thanks again for your help.

Best regards,
<Your name>
Accountant | Nile Power Solutions

Cc: Ms. Nadia Hassan
